headline: Lightning’s Brayden Point leaves game with undisclosed injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Brayden Point left Sunday's game against the Jets after five minutes of ice time and could miss future games, according to Jon Cooper. The club has not said what the injury is.

Tampa Bay can't easily absorb this. Point has 16 points in 16 games so far this season, but his results undersell him: his own expected goals (the quality of his chances) come to 6.54 against five actual goals, so he's been unlucky, not off. With him on the ice at five-on-five, TBL takes 60 percent of the expected goals, and the team's share is 6.5 points better with him than without. He's also on the first power-play unit, and TBL is at 11-3-2 with a 56.5 percent expected goal share overall.

Going by how the coach has used his players, Brandon Hagel (20:05 a night) is next in line for Point's minutes, and Anthony Cirelli, the busiest man on the second power-play unit, is the likeliest to move up there.
